```{r}
#| include: false

library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo=FALSE,
  warning=FALSE,
  message=FALSE,
  fig.align="center",
  out.width="100%"
)

results_dir <- "../results"

de <- read_csv(
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "differential_expression",
    "deseq2_results",
    "differential_expression.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

mapped <- read_csv(
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "functional_enrichment",
    "enrichment_results",
    "annotation",
    "mapped_DESeq2_results.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

summary_lines <- readLines(
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "functional_enrichment",
    "enrichment_results",
    "enrichment_summary.txt"
  )
)

get_summary_value <- function(label) {
  hit <- grep(
    paste0("^", label, ":"),
    summary_lines,
    value = TRUE
  )

  if (length(hit) == 0) {
    return(NA_integer_)
  }

  as.integer(
    trimws(
      sub(
        paste0("^", label, ":"),
        "",
        hit[1]
      )
    )
  )
}

de_genes <- nrow(de)
mapped_genes <- nrow(mapped)

sig <- !is.na(de$padj) &
  de$padj < 0.05 &
  abs(de$log2FoldChange) >= 1

significant_genes <- sum(sig)
up_genes <- sum(sig & de$log2FoldChange >= 1)
down_genes <- sum(sig & de$log2FoldChange <= -1)

gsea_genes <- get_summary_value("GSEA ranked genes")
```

# RNAFlowX

### A Reproducible Bulk RNA-seq Analysis Pipeline

**Author:** Sriram B

**Date:** `r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`

Built using **Nextflow • R • DESeq2 • clusterProfiler • Quarto**

</div>

## Executive Summary

RNAFlowX is a fully reproducible Bulk RNA-seq workflow that performs quality control, transcript quantification, differential expression analysis, Gene Ontology enrichment, KEGG pathway analysis and Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA).

::: {.section}
## 1. Analysis Overview

The analytical workflow implemented in RNAFlowX follows a fully reproducible pipeline:

**FASTQ → QC → Quantification → Count Matrix → DESeq2 → GO / KEGG → GSEA → HTML Report**
:::

::: {.section}
## 2. Quality Control

The workflow generates FastQC and MultiQC reports for all sequencing libraries. Quality metrics are consolidated into a single MultiQC report allowing rapid inspection of sequencing quality before downstream analysis.
:::

::: {.section}
## 3. Differential Expression

| Metric | Value |
|---|---:|
| Total genes | **`r format(de_genes, big.mark=",")`** |
| Significant genes | **`r format(significant_genes, big.mark=",")`** |
| Upregulated | **`r format(up_genes, big.mark=",")`** |
| Downregulated | **`r format(down_genes, big.mark=",")`** |

The differential expression analysis was performed using **DESeq2** with adjusted p-value {'<'} 0.05 and |log₂FC| ≥ 1.
:::

This concise Quarto report summarizes the final RNAFlowX production analysis. Detailed visualizations and functional-enrichment interpretation are provided in the full RNAFlowX scientific report.
